title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台
summary: 從iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 平台材料與套件
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「平台材料與套件」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine platform materials and kits, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Platform and wafer size: model and design
steps.objective: 以「平台與晶圓尺寸」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for platform and wafer size, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「平台與晶圓尺寸」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。iSiPP200 與 iSiPP300 是不同平台，晶圓直徑不是唯一差異，也不能假設元件庫可直接互換。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for platform and wafer size, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 are distinct platforms; diameter is not their only difference and libraries are not interchangeable. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。
steps.observationEn: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交平台與晶圓尺寸的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for platform and wafer size, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.

steps.objective: 以「元件庫邊界」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for library boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「元件庫邊界」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。公開元件清單提供能力入口；完整參數、設計規則和模型需要適用授權版本。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「建立元件、模型、版本與授權來源對照，不複製受限 PDK。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for library boundary, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Public component lists describe capabilities; full parameters, rules and models require the licensed revision. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Map devices, models, revisions and licensed sources without copying restricted PDKs. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.

steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立元件、模型、版本與授權來源對照，不複製受限 PDK。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「公開元件清單提供能力入口；完整參數、設計規則和模型需要適用授權版本。」與錯誤假說「iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。

Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Public component lists describe capabilities; full parameters, rules and models require the licensed revision." against the incorrect hypothesis "iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
